patch.value:
A valid Node stdin entrypoint has argv[1] equal to the literal dash. Importing the package entrypoint reaches referenceTrainerMain and isMainInvocation, which calls realpathSync on that dash and throws ENOENT. The same SDK import through node --input-type=module -e succeeds.

Reproduction from the package worktree:

```sh
printf '%s\n' "import './index.ts';" | node --input-type=module -
```

Expected: import completes without launching the reference trainer. Actual: import throws while resolving the stdin marker as a file. Keep the existing fail-closed behavior for genuinely missing script paths and its gate regressions. This distinct valid-stdin case was found while verifying PR 88 source hashes; it is outside the improver review fixes. The hash check succeeded through -e and all nine measured implementation hashes match.
Allow SDK imports from valid Node stdin entrypoints
The shared main-invocation guard resolves the stdin marker as a filesystem path during SDK import.
